text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool here, so please run it to confirm.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing `Emma`, so I added it. I made up the author and year (Austen, 1815) from the search tests.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it to an `int`.

I checked each fix by reading it against the tests.
